# Research {.page-title}

## Cognitive Neuroscience Lab, UW–Parkside

[Undergraduate Researcher · Jun 2024 – Aug 2025 · Advisor: Dr. Melissa Gregg]{.kicker}

- Designed and pilot-tested a study of perceptions of chatbot truth, deception, and user cognitive workload. Code: [github.com/Exios66/truth-deception-architecture](https://github.com/Exios66/truth-deception-architecture).
- Ran EEG systems and analyzed neural time-series data to measure brain activity, adding signal-processing and statistical analysis to existing lab research on sleep quality and cognitive load.
- Presented findings at the 2025 Midwestern Psychological Association conference.

## Graduate research, UW–Madison

[M.S. in Psychology: Data Science in Human Behavior · expected Dec 2026]{.kicker}

- The [Psychometric Digital Twin](projects/psychometric-digital-twin.qmd) study compares machine learning models and LLM personas on behavioral prediction.
- The [Digital-Mailroom](projects/digital-mailroom.qmd) capstone applies applied-AI methods to document processing with an industry partner.
